protocol: Recorded after anonymous numerical galleries and before new label tabulations. Earlier project images are familiar; not blinded validation.
face6_patch: Read all 39 panels (3 old plus 36 rank quantiles) spanning 221 returned images. New witnesses cluster near noses or muzzles across coat types and cats/dogs, with a near-boundary human brass player I054. Original tiger I426 still has a contextual site above its face. I110 witness is near the frame edge and partially cropped animal head. A broad facial response is plausible; patch-local sufficiency and global precision are not established.
face3_patch: Read all 35 returned images, visually dogs with marked sites near nose/muzzle, across framing, coats, breeds, lighting, and tongue states. Original I420, I110, I205 retained; 32 new images. Correlated face descriptors or dataset portrait bias remain alternatives to abstract feature identification.
texture_patch: Read all 39 selected panels of 228 images. Added-only query admits woven and knitted cloth, floral/polka-dot patterns, scales/fur/grass but also smoother animal surfaces, a wall above a cat, and a parachute/sky scene. Texture/context is plausible but the weaker set is visually broader; no unique shared local material is evident.
source_meet_image: Read 39 selected panels of 380 images. New matches include a refuelling person, church, golf balls, textures, pets and scenes. Blue maxima are often dispersed or at borders. No common patch satisfies all seven features. Background/context and common statistical features are possible; no single semantic explanation supported.
performance_image: Read all three images. Added-only 261-coordinate query preserves the same brass-player scenes, with minima at threshold and dispersed maxima. This is within-context numerical redundancy, not an independent new scene detector.
person_scene_image: Read all four images. Added-only 73-coordinate query preserves human-with-fish compositions. Distributed maxima involve people, fish and background; exact identity on four examples is not generalization.
singleton_controls: Read both singleton extents: dog tongue/collar I149 and woven surface I542. Removing original coordinates leaves the rest of their token codes and reselects the same item. High-dimensional instance specificity is a serious alternative to semantic generality.
